rationales.deterministic-orchestration-v2: form (a) + form (c) — implemented Python orchestration fixes the outermost sequence as Phase 1 independent analyses, Phase 2 cross-critiques, then Phase 3 arbitration, so providers cannot skip or reorder phases; the code dispatches each provider for a bounded analysis, critique, or synthesis call and routes persisted outputs into the next fixed stage. The system was run on 15 bugs, so it is not an unbuilt design.
